title: August home sales down 6.9% as economic headwinds threaten market momentum: CREA
summary: Canadian Real Estate Association says home sales are down 6.9 per cent year over year.

blocks.text: Canadian Real Estate Association says home sales are down 6.9 per cent year over year.
